id.description: Proxmox VM ID of the created virtual machine.

ip_address.description: First non-loopback IPv4 address reported by the QEMU guest agent. Null when the guest never reported one, which is always the case if wait_for_guest_ip_timeout is 0.

ip_addresses.description: All non-loopback IPv4 addresses reported by the QEMU guest agent for the created virtual machine.

lan_network_names.description: Names of the bridges attached to the LAN adapters, in adapter order.

name.description: Name of the created virtual machine.

node_name.description: Proxmox node the created virtual machine runs on.

uplink_network_name.description: Name of the bridge attached to the first (uplink) adapter.

annotation.description: Free-form notes recorded on the VM description.

datastore.description: ID of the Proxmox storage that will hold the cloned disks. Leave empty to use the template's storage.

lan_network_names.description: Names of the inside/LAN bridges (vnet IDs). One additional network adapter is created per entry, in list order, after the uplink adapter.

name.description: Name of the virtual machine as it will appear in Proxmox. Must be a valid DNS name.

network_name.description: Name of the bridge (vnet ID) that the first network adapter (the uplink or WAN side) attaches to.

node_name.description: Name of the Proxmox node the virtual machine runs on.

template_name.description: Name of the existing Proxmox VM template for the router appliance. It must be marked as a template and the name must be unique in the cluster.

wait_for_guest_ip_timeout.description: Minutes to wait for the QEMU guest agent to report a network address. Set to 0 to disable the agent and the wait, which is required for a template without qemu-guest-agent installed.

id.description: Proxmox VM ID of the created virtual machine.

ip_address.description: First non-loopback IPv4 address reported by the QEMU guest agent. Null when the guest never reported one, which is always the case if wait_for_guest_ip_timeout is 0.

ip_addresses.description: All non-loopback IPv4 addresses reported by the QEMU guest agent for the created virtual machine.

name.description: Name of the created virtual machine.

node_name.description: Proxmox node the created virtual machine runs on.

annotation.description: Free-form notes recorded on the VM description.

datastore.description: ID of the Proxmox storage that will hold the cloned disks. Leave empty to use the template's storage.

name.description: Name of the virtual machine as it will appear in Proxmox. Must be a valid DNS name.

network_name.description: Name of the bridge (vnet ID) that the network adapter attaches to.

node_name.description: Name of the Proxmox node the virtual machine runs on.

template_name.description: Name of the existing Proxmox VM template to clone. It must be marked as a template and the name must be unique in the cluster.

wait_for_guest_ip_timeout.description: Minutes to wait for the QEMU guest agent to report a network address. Set to 0 to disable the agent and the wait, which is required for a template without qemu-guest-agent installed.

network_names.description: Map of segment name to bridge name (vnet ID). Pass an entry to a compute module's network_name input. Available only after the SDN apply.

sdn_zone.description: SDN zone the segments were created in.

segment_names.description: Names of the created segments, in the order given.

name.description: Name of this exercise network. Prefixes every vnet alias and seeds the vnet IDs, so it must be unique on the cluster.

sdn_zone.description: ID of the existing Proxmox SDN zone that the segments are created in.

segment_names.description: Names of the isolated layer 2 segments to create, one vnet each.
